paragraphs: Mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 20:6, where R' Pinchas bar Chama asked him. Bamidbar Rabbah 2:24 reads R' Yochanan of Jaffa.[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״כ־ו and פ״ב־כד are read 20:6/2:24; historical machine פ״כחי/פ״ב-״כד differs, and the ו numeral was earlier unconfirmed against the scan. No fresh edition or image check is claimed.

דיפו is contextually of Jaffa, replacing an opaque Deifu romanization without a canonical geographic binding. Pinchas is the natural questioner and headed Yudan the asked person. Yochanan is Hyman’s reported alternative, not a new identity. All three personal-title abbreviations remain R'.
